name: zones_t14_seeded_parcellization
description: Conformance test 14 (seeded parcellization, §9). The zone developer's file-local generator is seeded from session 0 -> derive_seed(0, 0x8C09C68A) = 0x8C09C68A (foundations §6.3; the same seed the tract harness uses). A 2 × 2 region at x 10..11, z 20..21 is zoned 7 (agriculture) by PlaceZone(commit, skipFunds, skipSizeCheck), which triggers DoParcellization -> OnZone -> SimpleParcellize(16). SetOptions(0,0,0) so no automatic streets. Roads (type 0) on (9..12, 19) and (12, 19..22). SimpleParcellize draws one U(4) per cell in x-ascending-outer, z-ascending-inner order: (10,20),(10,21),(11,20),(11,21) -> U(4) = 3,0,3,0. CreateLotToFaceRoad tries sides in the drawn order and takes the first with a road of 0xC49: 3,0,1,2 -> side 0 has the road at (10,19) -> facing 0; 0,1,2,3 -> no road (the neighbours are lots) -> front 0; 3,0,1,2 -> side 0 road at (11,19) -> facing 0; 0,1,2,3 -> side 1 road at (12,21) -> facing 1. Result: four 1 × 1 lots facing 0,0,0,1; the generator advanced exactly 4 times (next NextRaw = 0xF27EB69F).
